items.subject: math
items.prompt: A hiker walks 1/2 mile in 1/4 hour. What is her speed in miles per hour?

items.subject: math
items.prompt: The graph of y = 5x passes through the point (1, 5). What does this point mean?
items.explanation: The point (1, r) shows the unit rate: when x is 1, y is r = 5.
choices: x and y are always both equal to 5.
The line crosses the y-axis at 5.
For every 1 unit of x, y is 5, so 5 is the unit rate.
items.answer: For every 1 unit of x, y is 5, so 5 is the unit rate.

commonErrors.answer: The line crosses the y-axis at 5.
commonErrors.why: confused the unit rate with the y-intercept

commonErrors.answer: x and y are always both equal to 5.
commonErrors.why: treated the point as the whole relationship

items.subject: math
items.prompt: Why does the graph of a proportional relationship include the point (0, 0)?
items.explanation: If you buy 0 pounds you pay $0. Zero of one quantity corresponds to zero of the other.
choices: Because the line must be horizontal
Because 0 of one quantity goes with 0 of the other quantity
Because the constant of proportionality is 0
Because every graph starts at the origin
items.answer: Because 0 of one quantity goes with 0 of the other quantity

commonErrors.answer: Because every graph starts at the origin
commonErrors.why: overgeneralized: graphs of other relationships need not pass through (0, 0)

commonErrors.answer: Because the constant of proportionality is 0
commonErrors.why: confused the point with the unit rate

commonErrors.answer: Because the line must be horizontal
